state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee who holds a team-lead role today? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q3: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by a regular department today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: mileage rate a business trip in a private petrol car 2026-03-15
state.step_intent: Find the mileage rate that applies to: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15?

passages.source: HB-40 §2 | Travel policy: private car use — Standard mileage rate | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-27
passages.text: Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 35 cents per km. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.

passages.source: HB-27 §2 | Travel policy: private car use — Standard mileage rate | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-40
passages.text: Business kilometres driven with a private car are reimbursed at 31 cents per km. Claims that combine several costs must list each cost on a separate line of the claim. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-40 §3 | Travel policy: private car use — Additions | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-04-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-27
passages.text: For trips towing a trailer, 7 cents per km was added to the standard mileage rate. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Amounts are stated in euros; conversions use the published rate on the day of payment. Repeated late or incomplete claims may be escalated to the head of the department.

passages.source: HB-38 §1 | Related budgets: private car use — Scope | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-04-01
passages.text: This document covers budgets related to, but separate from, the mileage rate. Any deviation from this section must be explained in the comment field of the claim. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Managers may reject claims that are not supported by the documentation described here.

passages.source: HB-34 §4 | Communication policy: mobile phones — Version status | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-05-01 to the day before 2026-03-01 · superseded by: HB-08
passages.text: This version applied from 2025-05-01 until the day before 2026-03-01. From 2026-03-01 it is superseded by HB-08; claims for earlier dates keep this version's amounts.
